class Checks {

  static String run(int n) {
    assert(n >= 0);
    try {
      assert(n < 10, 'too big: $n');
    } catch (e) {
      return 'caught: $e';
    }
    try {
      assert(n != 5);
    } catch (e) {
      return 'bare: $e';
    }
    return 'ok: $n';
  }

}

class Checks {

  static run(n) {
    if (!(n >= 0)) throw 'Assertion failed';
    try {
      if (!(n < 10)) throw `too big: ${n}`;
    } catch (e) {
      return `caught: ${e}`;
    }
    try {
      if (!(n !== 5)) throw 'Assertion failed';
    } catch (e) {
      return `bare: ${e}`;
    }
    return `ok: ${n}`;
  }

}
